set system host-name PE2.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols ldp discovery interface ge.command: set protocols ldp discovery interface ge-0/0/0
set protocols ldp discovery interface ge.explanation: Configures the LDP protocol to find the neighbor on the specified interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface, on which the LDP protocol will be found by the neighbour.

set protocols mpls label_protocol ldp.explanation: Configures the tag distribution protocol used by MPLS as LDP.

parameters.name: label_protocol
parameters.explanation: Label distribution protocol, here LDP.

set protocols l2vpn vpns vpn1.explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 VPN (L2VPN) instance named `[parameter1]` under the `protocols` hierarchy in Junos, enabling L2VPN services for that specific VPN.

parameters.name: vpn_name
parameters.explanation: Name of example VPN.

interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: This command configures an interface (`[parameter2]`) to be associated with a specific Layer 2 VPN (`[parameter1]`) in Junos, enabling L2VPN service on that interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: interface name, attached interface to the VPN example.

unit 0.explanation: The VPN example for the configuration of L2VPN binds the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

set protocols bgp peer-as 100.explanation: Configure the BGP protocol peer AS.

parameters.name: peer_as
parameters.explanation: BGP equivalent AS.

set protocols ospf area 0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: OSPF area ID.

network 192.168.10.0/24.explanation: Configure the assigned area network of the OSPF protocol.
